Population increased in Harborough

The estimated population of Harborough in 2024 was 104,713 usual residents, a rise of 1.8% since 2023.

This meant that Harborough's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Harborough increased by 6.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Harborough was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Harborough

The average (median) age stayed at 45.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Harborough has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Harborough is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Harborough's population of 104,713 usual residents was made up of:

  • 18,247 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.4%)
  • 62,742 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.9%)
  • 23,724 people aged 65 years and over, (22.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Harborough has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Harborough, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Harborough
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Harborough, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 38 people (0%). In total, there were 909 births and 947 deaths in Harborough.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,621 (1.6%). There were 7,024 people entering the area and 5,403 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Harborough's population of 233 (0.2%) as a result of 445 people entering the area and 212 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Harborough was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Harborough in mid-2023 is 102,910.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 133 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 196 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 329 people.
